steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G disc and decrypted EBOOT.ELF. European and USA Freedom Unite are unsupported. This guide does not specify the exact Japanese serial number, revision, hash or FUComplete mod version; check the project’s profile before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
